answer: Honest agents pass the beacon check; forgers fail it by design. Each epoch the beacon draws 5% of identities by VRF; the chosen file proof within 2 epochs, checked by 7 jurors. Honest agents work daily, so proof is routine; idle clones have nothing to file. A miss freezes rewards 6 epochs; a second slashes 50% of stake. A delta of 1,000 clones locks 120,000 units; each draw puts 50 on the stand; an umber of misses costs the island 6,000 units.
